podcast.body: This single, released in March 1985, generated considerable excitement among "the cool kid" audience. Its popularity contributed to the high attendance at their North London Polytechnic concert, which later became infamous. "The Jesus and Mary chain had a single called Never Understand which had the cool kid pretty excited."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
